prompts.text: Which song would you choose to introduce your personality to someone new?
We get to pick two songs for a short road trip. What's your opener?
An intimate acoustic concert or a lively outdoor music event?
Tell me about a song you recommended so enthusiastically your friends still remember it.
Disagreeing about music taste is often a fun way to get to know someone.
People's reactions to unfamiliar music reveal their sense of curiosity.
What's a song you know by heart but rarely mention?
A karaoke host invites us to sing a duet. What song would you suggest?
Trade playlists before meeting or introduce favourite tracks in person?
Which musician would you enjoy introducing me to and why?
